title: Step 2a: Linear to Polynomial Regression - Preparing Data for Advanced Models

cues.en: Instructor: Hello my friends.
cues.zh: 各位朋友，大家好。

cues.en: All right, so let's implement, quickly and efficiently, the linear regression model on the whole data set.
cues.zh: 快速有效地在完整資料集上建立線性迴歸。

cues.en: First, a quick reminder on what is the linear regression model that we're about to build.
cues.zh: 先回顧要建立的是哪個模型。

cues.en: We're simply about to build this one, right?
cues.zh: 就是這一個。

cues.en: Because we have only one feature, which is the position levels and the dependent variable, which is of course this salary, to predict.
cues.zh: 因為只有職位等級這一個特徵，以及要預測的依變數薪資。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 明白嗎？

cues.en: So that's what we'll do first, and then we'll, of course, implement the polynomial regression model with, I will tell you how many, powers of that same position level feature.
cues.zh: 先做這個，再建立多項式模型，使用同一個職位等級特徵的不同次方，稍後會說用幾次。

cues.en: Okay, so let's do this starting by creating a new code cell.
cues.zh: 建立新的程式儲存格。

cues.en: All right, so I hope you did it yourself first, to make sure you refresh your skills.
cues.zh: 希望你已先自行嘗試，複習技能。

cues.en: And so if that's the case, of course, you store it from the scikit-learn library, because that's the library that contains this LinearRegression class,
cues.zh: 如果有做，當然會從 scikit-learn 開始，因為它包含 LinearRegression 類別，

cues.en: which allows to build the linear regression model.
cues.zh: 可以建立線性迴歸模型。

cues.en: So scikit-learn, from which we're gonna get access to the linear_model which contains this class.
cues.zh: 從 sklearn 取得包含這個類別的 linear_model 模組。

cues.en: And from this linear_model, we're gonna import the LinearRegression class, as Google Collab guesses perfectly.
cues.zh: 再匯入 LinearRegression，Colab 的提示完全正確。

cues.en: Perfect, so that's the first step.
cues.zh: 第一步完成。

cues.en: Then we're gonna create an object of this class.
cues.zh: 再建立類別物件。

cues.en: So I know we used to call it regressor, but this time, since we're gonna have two regressors, you know, we're gonna have the linear regression regressor and the polynomial regression regressor.
cues.zh: 之前都叫 regressor，但這次有兩個迴歸模型，一個線性，一個多項式。

cues.en: Therefore, this time, I'm gonna call it lin_reg, for linear regressor, okay?
cues.zh: 所以這次叫 lin_reg，代表線性迴歸。

cues.en: So lin_reg will be created as an object of this LinearRegression class.
cues.zh: lin_reg 會建立為 LinearRegression 的物件。

cues.en: So I'm copying and pasting that here, adding some parentheses.
cues.zh: 複製、貼上，加括號。

cues.en: And remember, we don't have to input anything in these parentheses, because there is not much to tune in the linear regression model.
cues.zh: 別忘了，括號裡不必傳入設定，因為線性迴歸沒有太多需要調整的地方。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And finally, now we have, you know, the linear regression model, but it is not smart yet.
cues.zh: 現在有了模型，但它還沒有學會東西。

cues.en: It is not trained yet on this data set, you know, to understand and learn the correlations between the position levels and the salaries.
cues.zh: 還沒在資料上訓練，了解職位等級與薪資的關係。

cues.en: So that's what we're gonna do right now by using this fit method, which is exactly a training method that will train the model on these data.
cues.zh: 所以用 fit，也就是訓練方法，讓模型從這些資料學習。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So, to do this, we're gonna call our object first, lin_reg, from which we're gonna call the fit method, which, remember has to take as input,
cues.zh: 先取出 lin_reg，再呼叫 fit，它需要的輸入，

cues.en: the couple of matrix of features and dependent variable vector of the training set, right?
cues.zh: 是訓練資料的特徵矩陣與依變數向量。

cues.en: That's what we did before.
cues.zh: 之前就是這樣。

cues.en: But remember here, that we didn't split the data set into a training set and a test set, because we want to leverage the maximum data in order to train our model.
cues.zh: 但這次沒切分訓練與測試，因為希望用最多資料來訓練。

cues.en: And therefore, this time we're gonna take the whole matrix of features x, and the whole dependent variable vector y.
cues.zh: 所以傳完整的特徵矩陣 X，以及完整的 y。

cues.en: Alright?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So here we just input x and y, and there we go.
cues.zh: 直接輸入 X 與 y，完成。

cues.en: We built the linear regression model in a flashlight.
cues.zh: 很快建立了線性迴歸。

cues.en: So we're gonna execute this.
cues.zh: 執行。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: And now we have not only our model, but also a trained model on this data set.
cues.zh: 現在不只有模型，也已經用這份資料訓練完成。

cues.en: Okay, great.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: Now we're gonna close this, and we're gonna focus on the heart of the matter, which is the polynomial regression model.
cues.zh: 關閉這裡，聚焦這次的核心：多項式迴歸。

cues.en: I'm gonna teach you now how to build the polynomial regression model.
cues.zh: 現在教你如何建立多項式模型。

cues.en: All right, so we're gonna create a new code cell, and now we're gonna go back to this slide to explain exactly what we're gonna do.
cues.zh: 新增儲存格，回到投影片，說明要做什麼。

cues.en: All right, so as you understand, what we've just built so far is this model.
cues.zh: 剛才建立的是這個模型。

cues.en: We only have one featured position levels, and the dependent variable vector to predict, which are the salaries.
cues.zh: 只有職位等級一個特徵，以及要預測的薪資向量。

cues.en: Now, what we're gonna do, is we're gonna create a multiple linear regression model, but instead of having different features, you know, x1, x2, and xn,
cues.zh: 現在要建立類似多元線性迴歸的形式，但不是使用 x1、x2、xn 等不同特徵，

cues.en: well, these features will be x1, x1 squared, and x1 at the power of n.
cues.zh: 而是 x1、x1²，一直到 x1^n。

cues.en: And we'll actually tune this parameter n a bit to try several powers.
cues.zh: 也會稍微調整 n，試不同的次方。

cues.en: So, not to confuse, the polynomial linear regression is not a linear model, because you will see that it can learn some non-linear correlations, but we call it polynomial linear regression,
cues.zh: 別混淆，多項式迴歸可以學習特徵與目標間的非線性關係，但仍稱多項式線性迴歸，

cues.en: because, indeed, there is this linear combination of the squared n, you know, powered features, x1, x1 squared, and x1 at the power of n.
cues.zh: 因為它是 x1、x1² 到 x1^n 這些次方特徵的線性組合。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And so, the process of building this model on Python will be first to create a matrix of the powered features, you know, a matrix of features, but not containing different features
cues.zh: 在 Python 建模時，第一步先建立包含各次方的特徵矩陣，不是

cues.en: like x1, x2, and xn, but a matrix of features containing x1 as a first feature, then x1 squared as a second feature, and then x1 at the power of n as an nth feature.
cues.zh: x1、x2、xn 等不同變數，而是第一欄 x1、第二欄 x1²，一直到第 n 欄 x1^n。

cues.en: So that will be our matrix features, and we will call it x poly.
cues.zh: 這就是特徵矩陣，我們叫它 X_poly。

cues.en: And then we will create a linear regressor object, you know, from the LinearRegression class, to integrate these powered features
cues.zh: 再從 LinearRegression 建立線性迴歸物件，把這些次方特徵

cues.en: of this matrix of features, in this new linear regressor.
cues.zh: 整合進新的迴歸模型。

cues.en: You see the idea?
cues.zh: 了解了嗎？

cues.en: So it's a building process in two steps.
cues.zh: 所以建模分兩步。

cues.en: We're gonna first create the matrix of features containing these features at different powers, and then we'll integrate that into a linear regression model, because indeed,
cues.zh: 先建立不同次方的特徵矩陣，再放進線性迴歸，因為模型就是

cues.en: this is a linear combination of these powered features.
cues.zh: 這些次方特徵的線性組合。

cues.en: All right, perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So let's do this first step.
cues.zh: 先做第一步。

cues.en: The first step is to actually import this tool that will allow us to create this matrix of powered features.
cues.zh: 匯入能建立次方特徵矩陣的工具。

cues.en: You know, x1, x1 squared, and x1 at the power of n.
cues.zh: 也就是 x1、x1²，到 x1^n。

cues.en: And this class is called PolynomialFeatures.
cues.zh: 這個類別叫 PolynomialFeatures。

cues.en: So we're gonna import it first, which we can get from, once again, of course, the scikit-learn library, there we go.
cues.zh: 先匯入，一樣來自 scikit-learn。

cues.en: But this time, we're gonna get access to the pre-processing module, which contains that PolynomialFeatures class.
cues.zh: 不過這次使用 preprocessing 模組，PolynomialFeatures 在裡面。

cues.en: This is a class, because indeed, we're kind of pre-processing our x1 feature, because we want to create out of x1, well, x1, x1 squared, and x1 at the power of n.
cues.zh: 這有點像對 x1 做前處理，因為要從 x1，產生 x1、x1²，到 x1^n。

cues.en: So we're kind of doing pre-processing of the features.
cues.zh: 所以也是特徵前處理。

cues.en: All right, so from this pre-processing module, we're gonna import, well, that class, PolynomialFeatures.
cues.zh: 從 preprocessing 匯入 PolynomialFeatures。

cues.en: Perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。
